note: Small offline seed for version hints, not a CVE database. A hit is a lead; confirm against WPScan, Patchstack or NVD before reporting.

checks.title: WordPress readme is public
checks.advice: Remove readme.html or hide the version.

checks.title: WordPress REST user enumeration
checks.advice: Restrict or cache the users endpoint.

checks.title: XML-RPC is enabled
checks.advice: Disable it or rate limit it at the edge.

checks.title: WordPress debug.log is public
checks.advice: Move it out of the web root or block it.

checks.title: wp-config backup is public
checks.advice: Remove backup copies from the web root.

known.title: PHP CGI exposure range (when on PHP)
WordPress core range with known fixes

checks.title: Joomla administrator is public
checks.advice: Restrict by IP or add MFA.
